bestBets.overview: On pace runners,5, 9, 11, 12, 13. FRATIANNO was resuming with gear changes made at Port Macquarie when his effort within this distance range was full of merit, He clearly has scope to now improve at his second start since a stable change. CHEATING LILIBET was anything but disgraced at Port Macquarie first up when she was competing in the same race as FRATIANNO. She can only now present race-fitter when she makes her home base debut today. ELTON will concede race-day experience to all when he presents on debut today at his home base. After his Beaumont trial eleven days ago at Newcastle, this journey should be ideal at his first start. EXPENSIVE ICON must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort when he was produced here at home. A post-race issue was detected and that issue has now been resolved. SUVATHI and LAST METAPHOR are others with claims.

raceTips.comment: Fratianno has shown enough ability in recent runs and looks well placed to settle just off the speed, with the race shape giving him every chance to build through his work late. Cheating Lilibet has displayed enough speed to keep the leaders within range and should appreciate getting into a rhythm without having to chase too hard early.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 16. KONOMIE became unsuited in transit when he was resuming at Goulburn as a gelding for the first time. He kept trying on the day and he does have scope to improve! LOVE GODDESS made improvement third up within this distance range at Newcastle with Olivia Chambers aboard. She is suitably placed here with Olivia retaining the ride. RAGUEL kept trying in defeat first up at Port Macquarie in quick closing sectionals for the class. He should relish this step up from 1006m when he now makes a Taree debut. FASHION SPREE has handed in two solid efforts here recently after she's been produced fresh. She presents fresh again today and this race is within his reach. DON'T TELL HARRY presents for the first time since a stable change and numerous gear changes have been made. He hasn't been to the races for almost seven weeks but in his case, when he steps back in distance today, he's likely to cope.

raceTips.comment: Raquel looks nicely suited by this assignment and has the profile of a mare who can settle close enough to the speed before producing a sustained finishing effort. Parker's Paradise has been holding his form well and should be able to find a comfortable position, with his ability to keep grinding making him a threat late. Konomie has shown flashes of ability and could improve with a more economical run, particularly if the tempo allows him to conserve energy for the straight. Love Goddess has enough tactical speed to put herself into the race early and should be kept safe if she finds cover and gets clear running when required.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 5, 7. SURPASSER was attempting to lead throughout at Port Macquarie when he was presented second up. HIs third up effort last campaign was full of merit and this race is within his reach. ORDINARY ANGEL was solid in defeat after a gear change had been made at Quirindi and stepping up from 1450m can now be regarded as a plus. THE PROSPECT did a terrific job to finish as close to the winner as he did fifty-two days ago at Hawkesbury. He trialed ten days ago on the Beaumont track at Newcastle and he's now more than ready to make his Taree debut. ZENMODE must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort at Newcastle after he struck traffic problems. He will be better placed when he now makes a county circuit debut.

raceTips.comment: Surpasser has been racing with plenty of purpose and looks capable of controlling his own race from a forward position, while an in-form jockey on board adds confidence to the selection. Kowloon Magnate possesses the class to be competitive in this company and should be suited by being allowed to settle within striking distance before building momentum. Ordinary Angel has been putting together some solid efforts and has enough speed to stay in touch with the main contenders, with the mare capable of finishing strongly when produced at the right time. The Comanche is another capable runner who can make his presence felt if he finds the right rhythm and avoids covering unnecessary ground during the early stages.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 8, 10, 13, 14. DARK JUSTICE did all but win at Port Macquarie and he can be expected to maintain his form when he returns to Taree today. He did win his maiden here when he was produced on debut back in late December of last year. EXORBITANT MISS dug deep to score at Muswellbrook and she should now have more to offer when she makes her Taree debut. LONE STAR DREAM refused to shirk his task over this distance at Quirindi with Shannen Llewellyn aboard and he can also make his presence felt here with Shannen retaining the ride. SOUND AND VISION was produced fourth up at Quirindi when his unplaced effort over this distance was better than it appears on paper. He has scope to improve with that effort behind him.

raceTips.comment: Exorbitant Miss has been performing honestly and looks suited by a race where she can settle handy without being forced to work too hard early, giving her every opportunity to finish off strongly. Lone Star Dream has shown a willingness to race forward and should be able to make his own luck, with his strength late an important asset in this field. Dark Justice has enough ability to keep the pressure on and could prove difficult to run down if allowed to dictate terms for too long.

A tongue tie has now been added to her gear and she can appreciate this step up from 1262m today. I AM STEFFI presents in search of a hat-trick . She has the early pace to make her own luck in transit and this race is also within  her reach. JOSEPHINE must be forgiven for her unplaced latest Randwick effort when she was outclassed. She won't be outclassed when she now makes her Taree debut. PELOSA had too much to do when she was resuming last start at Grafton. She must be forgiven for her unplaced effort and she is proven second up!

raceTips.comment: I Am Steffi brings a solid level of form and looks well placed to settle just behind the leading runners before using her turn of foot when the pressure goes on, with an in-form jockey aboard another positive. Sirsa Nuwa has been racing consistently and should appreciate a race where she can find cover, allowing her to conserve energy before launching a late challenge. Pelosa has enough early speed to put herself into a favourable position and could prove difficult to dislodge if she gets the right economical run.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 7, 9, 12, 13. NOT WRITTEN OFF dug deep to win third up at Tamworth before she further improved on the same track last start. She presents now in search of a hat-trick and she should have more to offer,  BEER BARON also presents in search of a hat-trick. He will be making his Taree debut and after conceding most an early start, he can be expected to again find the line strongly. SHAGGY had too much to do at Wyong third up. He did all but win fourth up last preparation at Canterbury and he should not be underestimated here.  DIFENSIVO endured a tough run fifth up at Wyong. He can regain his best form today without causing any surprises.

raceTips.comment: Beer Baron has shown plenty of competitiveness and should be able to roll forward and make his own luck, which gives him a solid chance of being around the mark late. The Piccolino has enough ability to keep the pressure on and should benefit from finding a comfortable rhythm rather than being caught wide early. Shaggy has been working into his races well and can become a serious player if he gets the necessary cover before being produced for one finishing burst.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 7, 9, 11, 15. SHOW 'EM HOWL has finished unplaced at both attempts since a spell however, on both occasions, his efforts were better than they appear on paper. He's now ready to improve. ZARU performed well above market place expectations last start at Muswellbrook. He returns to his home base today and he must be treated with respect! JUST IN TIME makes her Taree debut third up and both unplaced outings since her spell must be completely disregarded. A POUND OF SALT handed in a solid effort at his Muswellbrook home base. He now makes a Taree debut and stepping up from 1280m can be regarded as a plus.

raceTips.comment: Show 'Em Howl has been building a strong body of form and looks suited by settling just off the pace, giving the gelding the chance to conserve energy before letting down in the straight. Zaru has the tactical speed to find a prominent position and should be able to keep himself within striking distance, with an in-form jockey aboard another positive for the selection. A Pound Of Salt has shown enough in recent appearances to suggest he can be competitive here, particularly if he gets a genuine tempo and is saved for one late run. Savvyrocker has been honest without breaking through and could sneak into the finish if the leaders overdo the early work and he gets the right trail throughout.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 5, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13. SINFULL raced greenly apprentice ridden third up at Grafton when she still did all but win. She will have scope to improve here with a senior jockey back aboard. FELIS CHAUS performed well above market place expectations last start at the Gold Coast and a repeat performance would allow him to again play a part when he now makes his Taree debut. DIRTY DOES IT was solid at his Port Macquarie home base when he was produced after a twenty-four day break. A quicker back-up now aids his cause. WILD PHAROAH is resuming without a lead-up trial however, unless market moves after she parades suggest otherwise, she can be expected to be ready to cope first up over this short journey today.

raceTips.comment: Sinfull has been racing consistently and looks capable of settling close to the speed, with the gelding possessing enough strength to keep finding the line when the pressure increases late. Dirty Does It has shown useful speed and should be able to put herself into the race early, with an economical run likely to bring her finishing qualities into play. The Magic Man has been showing signs of competitiveness and can give this a shake if he finds a comfortable position and is presented at the right time.
